mapper.select: SELECT j.id, j.job_type AS jobType, j.status, j.created_at AS createdAt, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(q.actual_tokens, q.estimated_tokens)), 0) FROM studyroom_generation_calls c JOIN ai_quota_reservations q ON q.request_id = c.quota_request_id WHERE c.job_id = j.id) AS tokens FROM studyroom_generation_jobs j WHERE j.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, email, username, status FROM users WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom_bookmarks WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classroom_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT MAX(updated_at) FROM classroom_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId}
